provenance.asset_description: Two images on a blurred background. On the left side of the image is a dragon composed of solid shadow sits upon a raised dais, menacingly preparing to strike. On the right is a lu-venon researcher, a quadrupedal marsupial alien species adapted to live in frigid temperatures, with dense fluffy fur. She wears a professional pink sweater and coat, a delicate silver headband, and a variety of bracelets and rings, and regards the viewer with cautious suspicion.
